gate: Test vectors: the Java verifier reproduces the challenge hashes of the browser byte for byte
statement: The Java verifier in the database reproduced 162/162 hashes of the browser byte for byte, over 18 fixed ballots in 2 key sizes (512 and 2048 bits), agreed with the browser on every verdict (6 accepted, 12 rejected) and verified 18/18 WebCrypto signatures. 6 altered vectors were all caught.

checks.name: every challenge hash and every signed-bytes hash is the same in the browser and in the database
the database accepts and rejects the same ballots as the browser
the samples contain both valid and invalid ballots
the database verifies every WebCrypto signature
checks.detail: 18/18 ECDSA P-256 signatures in P1363 format

checks.name: negative control: one digit of a ciphertext changed, the recorded hashes no longer match
checks.detail: 5 of 9 hashes differ; ballot: FAIL option 1: the challenges do not add up to the hash; signature: FAIL the signature does not match the ballot

checks.name: negative control: one digit of a response changed, the ballot is rejected
checks.detail: 2 of 9 hashes differ; ballot: FAIL option 1: the challenges do not add up to the hash

checks.name: negative control: the ballot number changed, the hashes change
checks.detail: 9 of 9 hashes differ; ballot: FAIL option 1: the challenges do not add up to the hash

checks.name: negative control: one digit of the signature changed, the signature is rejected
checks.detail: signature: FAIL the signature does not match the ballot; ballot: OK

checks.name: negative control: the signature presented with another voter code is rejected
checks.detail: signature: FAIL the signature does not match the ballot; ballot: OK

checks.name: negative control: the signature checked against another voter key is rejected
checks.detail: signature: FAIL the signature does not match the ballot
